contixo - f26 volant fpv drone with 4.3-.description: The Contixo F26 Volant Drone is designed for beginner pilots who want a simple screen-first flying experience without requiring a smartphone. The dedicated controller features a built-in 4.3-inch display for real-time FPV, while brushless motors and optical flow positioning help maintain steady hover and reduce drift. Four-sided infrared obstacle avoidance helps detect nearby objects, and beginner-friendly functions include one-key takeoff, landing, return, emergency stop, headless mode, auto hover, and gesture photo and video capture. The built-in 480P camera records at 15 fps with a 60-degree field of view, and FPV transmission reaches up to 240 feet. A removable 3.7V 2000mAh lithium-ion drone battery provides up to 14 minutes of flight time, while the included 1200mAh controller battery powers the 4.3-inch screen remote.
